subject: Random start delay on new connections

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Random start delay on new connections
parts:
I sometimes experience a significant delay connecting the web browser to shiny. The amount of time is random and sometimes 20+ seconds.

I get this for shiny server and runapp.

It only affects Linux (not windows)

I do have logic including MySQL connection in the first packet to the client. So it might not be shiny.

Anyone else get this?

I note that starving shiny logs a lot of failed attempts to open servers on inet ports below 1024... (Not named services but in the space reserved for services without a name).

I don't run shiny server as root.

-Alex
